metadata.purpose: supplementary non-trading study of a quiet doji after consecutive declines
metadata.outcome_clock: signal known at doji close; outcome starts at next open
metadata.matching: up to three nearest same-date controls in the same completed decline state

event_definitions.doji: abs(Close - Open) / (High - Low) <= 0.20; zero-range bars excluded
event_definitions.strict_three: three completed consecutive lower closes before doji and cumulative decline <= -3%
event_definitions.four_of_five: at least four lower closes in five completed days before doji and cumulative decline <= -5%
event_definitions.combined_control: same decline state without the full quiet-doji event
event_definitions.isolated_control: same decline and quiet-volume state without a doji
